svg.title: Archili Tskipuridze — cybersecurity, GRC, and software engineering
svg.desc: A unified visual portfolio for Archili Tskipuridze. Security Tool Development section: Aegis GRC application, Trellis, Aegis Helpdesk, and Aegis Website. Featured Thread tools: Threadforge, Threadnote, ThreadVoice, and ThreadToolbox. Thread ecosystem: Threadforge Mobile, ThreadCalendar, Threadplan, ThreadMail, ThreadStorage, Threadshot, ThreadAura, Threadlendar Dock, ThreadToolbox, ThreadMap, ThreadAccount, ThreadBots, ThreadStorage Android, ThreadStorage iOS, ThreadLens, Threadspace Website, ThreadSpace. Trellis is a GRC tool for a private company; work is ongoing in parallel. Utilities: AI Usage for Stream Deck, WoW Control, iOS Simulator for Windows, and Threadforge Stream Deck. Thread Releases is grouped with the Thread ecosystem. Thread OS remains at the research and planning stage. Most repositories are private. The supplied Thread Space icon-system reference is embedded once; matching Thread products show its colored monogram icons through SVG viewports. Aegis retains its existing eagle logo; Trellis retains its supplied lattice mark. The technology-logo toolbox is embedded, with colored Claude and JavaScript, Rust, Kotlin, Go, Swift, Lua, Python, Bash, HTML and CSS icons. Inter, Source Serif 4, and JetBrains Mono remain from ThreadMap. The user requested a more vivid palette: deeper graphite, coral and blue light, and original application logo colors. The existing HUD card shapes, the 400-pixel code portrait, and motion are preserved; the security projects and Thread tools have separate sections. The portrait is positioned at y=83, 15 pixels lower than the previous preview. Moving coral and blue background light, travelling card-edge accents, and a hero signal add motion. Decorative motion respects reduced-motion preferences.

symbol.desc: White TL monogram on a near-black square, framed by a lilac folded ribbon. Thread Space Icon Design System v1.0.
